issues.detail: The Greek 'ανηχθη' (anēchthē) is a passive/middle form of 'anichō' (to be permitted/allowed), but the Vietnamese 'Đức Chúa Trời cho phép' (God allows) attributes the permission to God as an active agent. The Greek structure implies 'if it be permitted' (passive/general possibility), not specifically 'if God permits'.
